Jek and Willis’ wedding day was a beautiful reflection of the love they have for one another. Their love brought tears during their private letters, brought Willis to tears at the first sight of Jek walking down the aisle, and showed in every way they looked at each other. From embracing Jek’s family traditions to being welcomed so deeply into her family, their day was filled with moments that felt less like a celebration and more like two families becoming one. We had the honor of capturing a love that was felt in every room, every embrace, and every tear.

Jek & Willis, may you keep writing your love story together for a lifetime, and may the Pensyl never run dry. ✏️❤️ Congratulations, you two!
